reviewed.reason: Development tooling only: the lockfile marks picomatch dev, reached through vitest, vite and @vscode/vsce (via fdir and tinyglobby), and none of it is bundled into the extension. The ReDoS needs an attacker-chosen glob; these tools match only the repository's own fixed patterns. No fixed release exists: every version up to 4.0.7, the newest, is affected. https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf
